content: After passing messages and performing updates for $T$ iterations, we obtain a matrix $\mathbf {H}^T \in \mathbb {R}^{n \times d}$ containing the final vertex representations. Let $\hat{G}$ be graph $G$ without the special document node, and matrix $\mathbf {\hat{H}}^T \in \mathbb {R}^{(n-1) \times d}$ be the corresponding representation matrix (i.e., $\mathbf {H}^T$ without the row of the document node).
